items.exampleEn: The insurance company paid for the things we lost in the burglary.
items.exampleZh: 保險公司賠償了我們在竊案中損失的東西。

items.exampleEn: He was a true patriot who loved his country deeply.
items.exampleZh: 他是一位深愛國家的真正愛國者。

items.exampleEn: She became the first woman chancellor of the university.
items.exampleZh: 她成為那所大學第一位女校長。
items.glossZh: 大學校長；（德、奧等國的）總理

items.exampleEn: In the play, the tyrant is finally defeated by his own son.
items.exampleZh: 在那齣戲裡，暴君最後被自己的兒子打敗。

items.exampleEn: The warship was painted gray so it was hard to see at sea.
items.exampleZh: 那艘軍艦漆成灰色，在海上很難被看見。

items.exampleEn: My little brother always hijacks the TV when I want to watch the news.
items.exampleZh: 我想看新聞時，我弟弟總是把電視搶走。

items.exampleEn: Only parliament has the power to legislate.
items.exampleZh: 只有國會擁有立法的權力。

items.exampleEn: He repressed the urge to check his phone during dinner.
items.exampleZh: 他晚餐時忍住了想看手機的衝動。

items.sentenceEn: The famous guest hijacked the interview and only talked about his new book.
items.sentenceZh: 那位名人把持了整場訪談，只談他的新書。

items.audioEn: The burglary happened on Sunday night, while the family was away on vacation.
items.audioZh: 竊案發生在星期日晚上，當時那家人出門度假了。
items.questionZh: 竊案發生時，那家人在哪裡？
options: Out of town on a trip

items.sentenceEn: It is hard to repress your feelings when you are very tired.
items.sentenceZh: 很累的時候，要壓抑自己的情緒很難。

items.sentenceEn: The warship sailed slowly out of the harbor at sunrise.
items.sentenceZh: 那艘軍艦在日出時緩緩駛出港口。

items.stemEn: Many people ____ painful memories from their childhood.
items.stemZh: 很多人會壓抑童年時痛苦的回憶。

items.stemEn: Our neighbors put new locks on their doors after a ____ on our street.
items.stemZh: 我們這條街發生竊案後，鄰居們都換了新的門鎖。

items.passageEn: Last Friday, the chancellor of our university opened a new sailing club for students. The club trains on an old warship named after a local patriot who lived two hundred years ago. At the first meeting, the club captain gave a long talk about safety and navigation. Some students joked that he was a tyrant, because he wanted everyone at the harbor by six every morning. Still, more than eighty students signed up on the first day, and the chancellor promised to join them for a trip in the spring.
items.passageZh: 上週五，我們大學的校長為學生成立了一個新的帆船社。社團在一艘舊軍艦上訓練，這艘船以兩百年前一位本地愛國者命名。第一次聚會時，社長花了很長時間講安全和航行。有些學生開玩笑說他是暴君，因為他要大家每天早上六點前到港口。即使如此，第一天就有八十多位學生報名，校長也答應春天要和他們一起出航。

questions.questionZh: 學生為什麼開玩笑說社長是暴君？
options: 他要大家每天六點到港口
他上課從不讓學生發問
他不准學生自己駕船出海
他每次訓練都大聲罵人
請愛國者的後代來演講

items.promptZh: 政府正在研究立法禁止塑膠吸管。
referenceEn: The government is planning to legislate against plastic straws.
The government is studying whether to legislate to ban plastic straws.
rubricZh: 要用 legislate（例如 legislate against、legislate to ban）
「研究」可寫，例如 is planning to、is studying whether to、is considering 等
時態用表示正在進行的寫法（例如 is planning）

items.instructionZh: 用 patriot 造一個句子，描述一位你心目中的愛國者（真實或虛構的人物都可以）。
referenceEn: Our history teacher often tells us about famous patriots from our country's past.
In the novel, the hero is a patriot who risks everything for his people.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 patriot（例如 a patriot who…）
時態配合內容（例如 was、is 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："Last Friday, the chancellor of our university introduced a famous historian in the main hall. Her talk was about a small island in the eighteenth century. For many years, the island was ruled by a tyrant who took most of the farmers' crops. Then a group of local patriots asked a friendly ally for help, and a warship carried their message across the sea. In the end, the tyrant left the island, and a new council was formed to legislate fair taxes. The talk was so popular that many students had to stand."；改後："Last Friday, the chancellor of our university opened a new sailing club for students. The club trains on an old warship named after a local patriot who lived two hundred years ago. At the first meeting, the club captain gave a long talk about safety and navigation. Some students joked that he was a tyrant, because he wanted everyone at the harbor by six every morning. Still, more than eighty students signed up on the first day, and the chancellor promised to join them for a trip in the spring."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：FIX 14：中譯同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："上週五，我們大學的校長在大禮堂介紹了一位知名的歷史學家。她演講的主題是十八世紀的一座小島。許多年來，這座島由一位暴君統治，他拿走了農民大部分的收成。後來，一群當地的愛國者向友好的盟友求助，一艘軍艦把他們的訊息送過大海。最後暴君離開了小島，島上成立新的議會，制定公平的稅法。這場演講非常受歡迎，許多學生只能站著聽。"；改後："上週五，我們大學的校長為學生成立了一個新的帆船社。社團在一艘舊軍艦上訓練，這艘船以兩百年前一位本地愛國者命名。第一次聚會時，社長花了很長時間講安全和航行。有些學生開玩笑說他是暴君，因為他要大家每天早上六點前到港口。即使如此，第一天就有八十多位學生報名，校長也答應春天要和他們一起出航。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：作者疑慮1稱 hijack 情境句用比喻，但單字卡例句是「飛機在飛往巴黎途中遭劫持」的字面劫機情境（雖為電影），屬恐怖攻擊類沉重題材；疑似應改用較中性的情境（如劫持貨車、或比喻用法）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 中 items/5 的修正紀錄。

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：「a new council was formed to legislate fair taxes」：legislate 多為不及物（legislate for／against），直接接受詞 fair taxes 不常見，疑似不道地；建議 to pass laws for fair taxes 或 to legislate for fair taxes。另 a friendly ally 語意重複（ally 已含友方）。
